title: repro run rotates the area order per instance and starts no area the cap cannot cover
goal: repro run gives instance n the briefs' areas in the order bench_repro.area_order(areas, n, count) returns, the list rotated by (n-1) times len(areas)//count, and records each instance's order in run.json; it starts an area only when bench_repro.may_start(spent, area_usd, instance_usd) holds, the recorded spend plus --area-usd within --instance-usd, so no instance passes its cap; repro run --dry-run prints each instance's order and the areas its cap leaves out

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_repro as b
if not hasattr(b,'area_order'): print('no area_order yet');sys.exit(1);a=list('abcdef')
ok=b.area_order(a,1,3)==a and b.area_order(a,2,3)==list('cdefab') and b.area_order(a,3,3)==list('efabcd')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_repro as b
if not hasattr(b,'may_start'): print('no may_start yet');sys.exit(1);sys.exit(0 if b.may_start(50,8,58) and not b.may_start(50.01,8,58) else 1)

import inspect,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_repro as b
s=inspect.getsource(b)
sys.exit(0 if 'area_order(' in s and 'may_start(' in s and 'leaves out' in s else 1)

clauses.clause: repro run gives instance n the briefs' areas in the order bench_repro.area_order(areas, n, count) returns, the list rotated by (n-1) times len(areas)//count
records each instance's order in run.json
it starts an area only when bench_repro.may_start(spent, area_usd, instance_usd) holds, the recorded spend plus --area-usd within --instance-usd, so no instance passes its cap
repro run --dry-run prints each instance's order and the areas its cap leaves out

notes: Premise (lessons analysis 1.6, 4.2): all 10 budget failures of the first run were tail areas of the one fixed order (age to pip; pip run by none, instance 3 lost 7), and the cap was checked before an area so spend passed it (59.09, 60.79 against 58). The rotation and the reserve rule are the analysis's recommendation 6; the function names are fixed here so the checks can call them. Checks that pass before the work: the test selection pass before the work and are kept as guards (the change must keep them green); checks 0 and 1 fails before the work and reads the goal. Each guard check named above as passing on the base passes before the work: it pins behaviour that must stay green (a test selection the work extends, the eval, the lint); the item's failing checks read its goal.
